description:
This process begins with monitoring inventory levels in a warehouse or store.
When stock reaches a predefined threshold, an automated alert or manual check signals the need to reorder.
The procurement team then places an order with suppliers, considering factors like cost, delivery time, and supplier reliability.
Once the order is placed, the inventory system updates with expected delivery dates.
Upon receiving the stock, it is inspected for quality, recorded in the system, and placed on shelves or in storage.
The process ends when the inventory levels are updated after the restock is complete.
generated_bpmn_xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/inventory-replenishment">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Order" name="Supplier order"/>
  <bpmn:process id="Process_InventoryReplenishment" name="Inventory replenishment" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Monitoring" name="Begin inventory monitoring">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Start_Monitor</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_MonitorInventory" name="Monitor inventory levels">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Start_Monitor</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_BelowThreshold</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Monitor_Threshold</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Threshold" name="Stock at predefined threshold?" default="Flow_BelowThreshold">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Monitor_Threshold</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_AtThreshold</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_BelowThreshold</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AlertOrCheck" name="Choose reorder signal">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_AtThreshold</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_AutomatedAlert</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ManualCheck</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_AutomatedAlert" name="Generate automated reorder alert">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_AutomatedAlert</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Alert_ReorderMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>
    <bpmn:manualTask id="Task_ManualCheck" name="Perform manual reorder check">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ManualCheck</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Check_ReorderMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:manualTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ReorderMerge" name="Reorder signal received">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Alert_ReorderMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Check_ReorderMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Merge_PlaceOrder</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_PlaceOrder" name="Place supplier order considering cost, delivery time, and reliability" messageRef="Message_Order">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Merge_PlaceOrder</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Order_UpdateDates</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_UpdateExpectedDates" name="Update expected delivery dates in inventory system">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Order_UpdateDates</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_UpdateDates_ReceiveStock</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReceiveStock" name="Receive stock">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_UpdateDates_ReceiveStock</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Receive_Inspect</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_InspectQuality" name="Inspect stock quality">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Receive_Inspect</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Inspect_Record</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RecordStock" name="Record stock in system">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Inspect_Record</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Record_StorageChoice</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_StorageChoice" name="Choose placement">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Record_StorageChoice</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_PlaceOnShelves</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_PlaceInStorage</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PlaceOnShelves" name="Place stock on shelves">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_PlaceOnShelves</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Shelves_StorageMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PlaceInStorage" name="Place stock in storage">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_PlaceInStorage</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Storage_StorageMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_StorageMerge" name="Stock placement complete">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Shelves_StorageMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Storage_StorageMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_StorageMerge_UpdateInventory</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_UpdateInventoryLevels" name="Update inventory levels after restock">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_StorageMerge_UpdateInventory</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_UpdateInventory_End</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_RestockComplete" name="Inventory levels updated">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_UpdateInventory_End</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_Monitor" sourceRef="StartEvent_Monitoring" targetRef="Task_MonitorInventory"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Monitor_Threshold" sourceRef="Task_MonitorInventory" targetRef="Gateway_Threshold"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AtThreshold" name="Threshold reached" sourceRef="Gateway_Threshold" targetRef="Gateway_AlertOrCheck">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">stockAtOrBelowThreshold</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BelowThreshold" name="Threshold not reached" sourceRef="Gateway_Threshold" targetRef="Task_MonitorInventory"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AutomatedAlert" name="Automated alert" sourceRef="Gateway_AlertOrCheck" targetRef="Task_AutomatedAlert"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ManualCheck" name="Manual check" sourceRef="Gateway_AlertOrCheck" targetRef="Task_ManualCheck"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Alert_ReorderMerge" sourceRef="Task_AutomatedAlert" targetRef="Gateway_ReorderMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Check_ReorderMerge" sourceRef="Task_ManualCheck" targetRef="Gateway_ReorderMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Merge_PlaceOrder" sourceRef="Gateway_ReorderMerge" targetRef="Task_PlaceOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Order_UpdateDates" sourceRef="Task_PlaceOrder" targetRef="Task_UpdateExpectedDates"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_UpdateDates_ReceiveStock" sourceRef="Task_UpdateExpectedDates" targetRef="Task_ReceiveStock"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Receive_Inspect" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveStock" targetRef="Task_InspectQuality"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Inspect_Record" sourceRef="Task_InspectQuality" targetRef="Task_RecordStock"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Record_StorageChoice" sourceRef="Task_RecordStock" targetRef="Gateway_StorageChoice"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PlaceOnShelves" name="Shelves" sourceRef="Gateway_StorageChoice" targetRef="Task_PlaceOnShelves"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PlaceInStorage" name="Storage" sourceRef="Gateway_StorageChoice" targetRef="Task_PlaceInStorage"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Shelves_StorageMerge" sourceRef="Task_PlaceOnShelves" targetRef="Gateway_StorageMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Storage_StorageMerge" sourceRef="Task_PlaceInStorage" targetRef="Gateway_StorageMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StorageMerge_UpdateInventory" sourceRef="Gateway_StorageMerge" targetRef="Task_UpdateInventoryLevels"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_UpdateInventory_End" sourceRef="Task_UpdateInventoryLevels" targetRef="EndEvent_RestockComplete"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_InventoryReplenishment">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_InventoryProcess" name="Inventory replenishment process" processRef="Process_InventoryReplenishment"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Supplier" name="Supplier"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_OrderToSupplier" name="Supplier order" sourceRef="Task_PlaceOrder" targetRef="Participant_Supplier" messageRef="Message_Order"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>
</bpmn:definitions>
